name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal on the native <dialog>: showModal() traps focus and blocks the page, Escape closes it, focus returns to the opener. Any element with data-sg-dialog opens it; without JavaScript that element is a real link to a real page. Quiet is a plain dimmed backdrop; warm and playful are full-bleed with the Carepa surface behind a floating card, mounted only while open.

budget.reason: 0010: element (dialog.js) + core (dialog.core.js) together, since the pure core here is small (openersFor, isDismiss, STRINGS) and not worth a separate 12 KB allowance. Today 5781 bytes for behaviour, plus three skins (quiet 0.3 KB, warm 0.8 KB, playful 1.2 KB); Carepa itself is a separate registry item.
